name: complexipy
description: Cognitive complexity for Python as you type: inlay hints, hover details, and warnings from the complexipy language server

complexipy.server.path.markdownDescription: Path to the `complexipy` executable. The extension runs `<path> lsp`. Leave empty to use `complexipy` from the `PATH`.

enumDescriptions: Show the language server's inlay hints, as set in `[tool.complexipy.lsp]`.
Show colored badges: `ƒ N` after every function and `+N` after every line that adds complexity.
complexipy.display.markdownDescription: How complexity appears in the editor. `decorations` colors each badge green, yellow, or red.

complexipy.decorations.lineWarningAt.markdownDescription: A line badge turns yellow when the line adds at least this much complexity. Applies when `complexipy.display` is `decorations`.

complexipy.decorations.lineErrorAt.markdownDescription: A line badge turns red when the line adds at least this much complexity. Applies when `complexipy.display` is `decorations`.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In Restricted Mode, complexipy ignores complexipy.server.path from workspace settings and runs complexipy from your user settings or the PATH.
